subject: mine-harness-evolution

metrics.name: Mine Harness — automated card mining
evolution_plan: 1. Add card_miner.py — auto-discovers new subjects (models, claims, regulations) from public APIs
2. Add evolve_banks.py — uses GA/RL to evolve bank weights based on accuracy deltas
3. Add self_correct.py — auto-fills corrections ledger when drift detected
4. Add auto_publish.py — pushes signed cards to public root + GitHub Pages + RSS
5. Add watchdog_asi.py — monitors full pipeline, restarts on stall, escalates on failure
metrics.automation_target: 100% automated — no human in loop. Cron fires every 2h. Pod runs continuously.
metrics.human_role: Only owner gates: wallet signatures, regulatory submissions, social posts

honest_sentence: Mine harness evolution: add card_miner + evolve_banks + self_correct + auto_publish + watchdog_asi. Target 100% automation — cron every 2h, pod continuous, no human in measurement loop.
